'''FK Viktoria Žižkov''' is a Czech professional [[association football|football]] club from the district of [[Žižkov]] in [[Prague]]. The club competes in the [[Czech National Football League]], the second tier of football in the country. It won the [[Czechoslovak First League]] title in the 1927–28 season, and has also won two editions of the [[Czech Cup]]."}}
